# apipbx_pin_set (Resource)

A set of PINs an outbound route can require. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `pins` (Set of String, Sensitive) PINs of 3-12 digits; any one of them lets a call through a route that requires this set.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
